sub_strands.name: Listening Comprehension
sub_strands.description: Listening to and understanding spoken texts, instructions and narratives

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to listen attentively and extract main ideas from spoken texts
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to respond appropriately to instructions and questions based on what is heard

sub_strands.name: Pronunciation and Intonation
sub_strands.description: Producing sounds, stress and intonation patterns accurately

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to pronounce words and sounds accurately
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to use stress and intonation to convey meaning

sub_strands.name: Oral Presentation
sub_strands.description: Speaking fluently and coherently on varied topics

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to present ideas orally in a clear and organized manner
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to use appropriate non-verbal cues during oral presentations

sub_strands.name: Reading Fluency
sub_strands.description: Reading accurately, at a reasonable pace and with expression

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to read age-appropriate texts fluently and with comprehension
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to read with appropriate expression and intonation

sub_strands.name: Reading Comprehension Skills
sub_strands.description: Literal, inferential and evaluative comprehension of varied texts

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to identify main ideas, themes and supporting details in a text
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to make inferences and draw conclusions from what they read
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to evaluate texts critically and express opinions

sub_strands.name: Paragraph and Essay Writing
sub_strands.description: Developing coherent paragraphs and multi-paragraph compositions

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to write well-structured paragraphs with topic sentences
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to write coherent essays on given topics

sub_strands.name: Creative Writing
sub_strands.description: Writing imaginative pieces including narratives, poems and dialogues

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to write imaginative narratives with a clear sequence of events
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to use descriptive and figurative language in creative writing

sub_strands.name: Functional Writing
sub_strands.description: Writing letters, reports, notices and other practical texts

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to write formal and informal letters appropriately
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to write reports and notices using the correct format

sub_strands.name: Genres of Literature
sub_strands.description: Identifying and appreciating oral, written and visual forms of literature

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to identify different genres of literature
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to appreciate the values embedded in literary texts

sub_strands.name: Literary Devices
sub_strands.description: Identifying and interpreting figurative language and stylistic devices

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to identify literary devices in given texts
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to explain the effect of literary devices on meaning

sub_strands.name: Character and Theme Analysis
sub_strands.description: Analysing characters, themes and messages in set books

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to analyse characters and their roles in a literary text
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to relate themes in literature to real-life situations

sub_strands.name: Usikivu

sub_strands.description: Kutamka sauti na maneno kwa usahihi

learning_outcomes.outcome: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze kutamka maneno kwa usahihi

sub_strands.name: Ufahamu
sub_strands.description: Kuelewa na kufasiri matini zilizosomwa

learning_outcomes.outcome: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze kujibu maswali ya ufahamu kwa usahihi

sub_strands.name: Insha
sub_strands.description: Kuandika insha za kueleza, kusimulia na kubuni

sub_strands.name: Fasihi Simulizi
sub_strands.description: Kuthamini hadithi, methali, vitendawili na ngano

learning_outcomes.outcome: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze kueleza aina za fasihi simulizi

sub_strands.name: Fasihi Andishi
sub_strands.description: Kusoma na kuchambua tamthilia, riwaya na mashairi

sub_strands.name: Whole Numbers and Place Value
sub_strands.description: Reading, writing and operating on large whole numbers

sub_strands.description: Operations on positive and negative integers

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to represent integers on a number line
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to perform operations on integers

sub_strands.name: Rational Numbers
sub_strands.description: Fractions, decimals and percentages

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to convert between fractions, decimals and percentages
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to solve problems involving rational numbers

sub_strands.name: Ratios, Rates and Proportions
sub_strands.description: Comparing quantities and solving proportional problems

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to simplify and share quantities in given ratios
By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to apply rates and proportions to real-life problems

learning_outcomes.outcome: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to compute the mean, median and mode of data sets

sub_strands.name: Probability

By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to explain changes of state using particle theory
